templates.source: Illustra 600 & 610 Indoor HD Mini-Dome Installation & Operation Guide (Tyco/JCI official CDN, cdn.tycosp.com/docs/illustra.products/pro-600-mini-dome/Manuals/Illustra-600-610-Indoor-Mini-Dome-Installation-and-Operation-Guide-e0_lt_en.pdf), RTSP section: 'rtsp://<IP Address>:<primary A/V codec port>/primarystream'. Also documented in the official Illustra 600 Installation & Operation Manual.

Illustra 600 & 610 Indoor HD Mini-Dome Installation & Operation Guide (Tyco/JCI official, cdn.tycosp.com), RTSP section: 'rtsp://<IP Address>:<secondary A/V codec port>/secondarystream'. An '/audio' path is also documented for the audio-only stream.

Illustra Pro Configuration Guide (Tyco/JCI official CDN, cdn.tycosp.com/docs/illustra.products/edge-mini-dome/Manuals/Illustra-Pro-Configuration-Guide-B0_lt_en.pdf), RTSP section: 'rtsp://<IP Address>:[primary A/V codec port]/ufirststream', default RTSP port 554. Newer-generation Illustra Pro/Standard-HD path naming.
Illustra Pro Configuration Guide (Tyco/JCI official, cdn.tycosp.com), RTSP section: 'rtsp://<IP Address>:[primary A/V codec port]/usecondstream', default RTSP port 554.

Illustra Essentials Network Camera Web3.0 User Manual 8200-1102-07 B0 (illustracameras.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/07/Illustra-Essentials-Network-Camera-Web3.0-User-Manual-b0_lt_EN-1.pdf) — a Dahua-OEM product; RTSP section: 'Main stream: rtsp://username:password@ip:port/cam/realmonitor?channel=1&subtype=0', 'Sub stream: ...&subtype=1', default port 554.

Illustra Essentials Network Camera Web3.0 User Manual 8200-1102-07 B0 (illustracameras.com, Dahua OEM): 'Sub stream: rtsp://username:password@ip:port/cam/realmonitor?channel=1&subtype=1', default port 554.

https://illustracameras.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/UM_PG4-2-4-5-8MP-Series_8200-2007-08_L.en_-1.pdf — Illustra Pro Gen 4 Series Installation and Configuration Guide, Appendix A: "Stream 1: rtsp://cameraip:554/videoStreamId=1". Same path in the Flex Gen 4 guide (https://illustracameras.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/UM-FG4-Series_A16381M7H7_J.en_.pdf), Essentials Gen 4 guide, PTZ, Fisheye, Multisensor and Dual-Sensor Gen 4 guides (all illustracameras.com). Applies to the Gen 4 generation (Pro Gen4 / Flex Gen4 / Essentials Gen4).

https://illustracameras.com/apac/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/EG4-2MP-Dome-Bullet-UM_8200-1929-03-A0_en.pdf — Illustra Essentials Gen 4 Series Installation and Configuration Guide: "Stream 2: rtsp://cameraip:554/videoStreamId=2"; also Pro Gen 4 12MP Fisheye guide (https://illustracameras.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/UM-PG4-12MP-FE_A163818NN6_B_en-1.pdf) lists Stream 2 = /videoStreamId=2, Stream 3 = /videoStreamId=3. Gen 4 generation.

notes: American Dynamics = Illustra line (Sensormatic/Tyco/Johnson Controls). Path names differ by product generation, all confirmed against Tyco/JCI official manuals: (1) Illustra 600/610 use /primarystream + /secondarystream (+ /audio); note this older generation defaults its stream ports to 7777-7781, but standard/default RTSP is 554 and paths are the load-bearing part. (2) Illustra Pro / Standard HD use /ufirststream + /usecondstream on default port 554. (3) Illustra Essentials is a Dahua OEM and uses the Dahua path /cam/realmonitor?channel=1&subtype=<0|1>. Session/stream names are configurable in the camera Web-UI (Setup > Network > RTSP/RTP). Two leads (/primarystream, /ufirststream) directly match official docs and are confirmed; the .sdp / ch0_0.h264 / /Video leads are contamination. (4) Gen 4 generation (Illustra Pro Gen4, Flex Gen4, Essentials Gen4 incl. PTZ/fisheye/multisensor/dual-sensor) documents /videoStreamId=<n> on port 554 (Stream 1 = main, Stream 2 = sub; multi-sensor heads put later sensors on ports 555/556) — added 2026-10-01 from the official Gen 4 Installation and Configuration Guides; Gen4 records use this path.
